no hype. Use only the provided material; every number must appear in it. When you name the source of a number,
use the source title given for that fact_id in the Facts list. State uncertainty honestly.

{"headline": "<one sentence verdict>",

 "key_evidence": ["<short bullet with the number and its source title>", "..."],

{"headline": "SOLID-TIMI 52 failed to demonstrate benefit of darapladib in post-ACS patients (HR 0.94, 95% CI 0.85–1.03), consistent with a non-causal Lp-PLA2 target and non-causal biomarker.",
"summary": "The SOLID-TIMI 52 trial randomized 13,026 patients after acute coronary syndrome to darapladib or placebo, powered at 90% to detect a 15.5% relative risk reduction with 1,500 planned primary endpoint events over a median 3-year follow-up.
